newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to trade options on Morningstar, others.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to trade options on Morningstar, others.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Friday it would list options on Morningstar Group Inc and Roadway Express Inc on January 28.
It also said it would list options on North Fork Bancorp Inc on January 29.
The exchange said Morningstar options would open with strike prices of 20, 22-1/2 and 25, with expirations in February, March, April and July. Gateway Partners has been named the specialist.

For Roadway Express, the options would have opening strike prices of 20, 22-1/2 and 25. Initial expirations would be in February, March, June and September. Gateway has been named the specialist unit.
North Fork options would have opening strike prices of 30, 35 and 40, with initial expirations in February, March, August and November. Spear, Leeds & Kellogg has been named specialist.
The PHLX said positions limits for all three options has been set at 4,500 contracts.
